notablePrerequisites:
Hankyu attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the first Hankyu ability by tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Warchanter Skald activated ability, putting an aim counter on Hankyu.
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Warchanter Skald using the other ability granted by Hankyu, removing all aim counters and dealing that much damage to an opponent.
Repeat.
